metric.name: binder_wait_ms
metric.sql_used:
INCLUDE PERFETTO MODULE android.binder;
INCLUDE PERFETTO MODULE android.frames.timeline;
WITH
  window_frames AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT f.upid, f.ui_thread_utid, a.id, a.dur, a.jank_type
    FROM android_frames_layers AS f
    JOIN actual_frame_timeline_slice AS a ON a.id = f.actual_frame_timeline_id
    WHERE f.layer_name NOT GLOB '*SurfaceView*' AND a.dur > 0
  ),
  app AS (
    SELECT upid FROM window_frames GROUP BY upid ORDER BY count(*) DESC, upid LIMIT 1
  ),
  frames AS (
    SELECT * FROM window_frames WHERE upid = (SELECT upid FROM app)
  )
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM frames)
      OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM android_binder_txns) THEN NULL
    ELSE coalesce((
      SELECT sum(client_dur) FROM android_binder_txns
      WHERE is_sync AND client_dur > 0
        AND client_utid IN (SELECT ui_thread_utid FROM frames)
    ), 0) / 1e6
  END AS value

claims.text: Synchronous binder wait on the app's UI thread increased from 287.81833 ms in the baseline trace to 348.319381 ms in the current trace, a delta of 60.501051 ms.

INCLUDE PERFETTO MODULE android.frames.timeline;
WITH
  window_frames AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT f.upid, f.ui_thread_utid, a.id, a.dur, a.jank_type
    FROM android_frames_layers AS f
    JOIN actual_frame_timeline_slice AS a ON a.id = f.actual_frame_timeline_id
    WHERE f.layer_name NOT GLOB '*SurfaceView*' AND a.dur > 0
  ),
  app AS (
    SELECT upid FROM window_frames GROUP BY upid ORDER BY count(*) DESC, upid LIMIT 1
  ),
  frames AS (
    SELECT * FROM window_frames WHERE upid = (SELECT upid FROM app)
  ),
  ranked AS (
    SELECT s.dur AS ns, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY s.dur) AS rank,
      count(*) OVER () AS n
    FROM android_frames_choreographer_do_frame AS d
    JOIN slice AS s USING (id)
    WHERE d.ui_thread_utid IN (SELECT ui_thread_utid FROM frames)
  )
SELECT (SELECT ns / 1e6 FROM ranked WHERE rank = (n * 95 + 99) / 100) AS value

claims.text: The range contains UI changes such as the four-second TV-control timeout, increased download-row padding, and a FeedRow player-acquisition rewrite, but the trace evidence does not directly connect any of them to the additional binder wait.

caveats: Each side has only one capture, so the 60.501051 ms binder delta may include run-to-run variance.
The current run is a non-debuggable benchmark build on an Android SDK 36 emulator.
Startup TTID/TTFD could not be measured because both traces lacked the required startup data.
